context: A formal PTA committee meeting. Asuka and Hiroshi-boss go over the budget for the autumn event.
purpose: formal civic planning — careful adult committee work

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 本日は、予算について、お時間いただきます。
lines.en: Today, regarding the budget, I'll take your time.
lines.style: Teacher warm formal professional careful chair-opening, the soft real respectful audible, gentle real composure throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい、よろしくお願いします。資料、拝見しました。
lines.en: Yes, please. I've reviewed the documents.
lines.style: Boss measured warm formal prepared-respectful, the soft real authority-soft audible, gentle real composure throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 今回の行事、資金が少し足りなくて。
lines.en: For this event, funds are slightly short.
lines.style: Teacher warm formal careful honest-explaining, the soft real respectful audible, gentle real composure throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: どのくらい足りないのでしょうか？
lines.style: Boss measured warm professional clear-inquiring, the soft real respectful audible, gentle real composure throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 五万円ほどです。負担を、皆さんでどう分けるか、検討中で。
lines.en: About fifty thousand yen. How to share the burden — under consideration.
lines.style: Teacher warm formal specific-honest careful-presenting, the soft real respectful audible, gentle real composure throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: では、提案ですが。地域の企業からの寄付、相談してみては。
lines.en: Then, a proposal — what about consulting with local businesses for donations?
lines.style: Boss measured warm sincere strategic-proposing-thoughtful, the soft real respectful audible, gentle real composure throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: なるほど、検討してみます。ありがとうございます。
lines.en: I see, I'll consider it. Thank you.
lines.style: Teacher warm formal sincere committed-grateful, the soft real respectful audible, gentle real composure throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: こちらでもできること、お手伝いします。
lines.en: On my side too, I'll help where I can.
lines.style: Boss measured warm sincere generous-extending closing, the soft real respectful audible, gentle real composure throughout delivery.
